lesson: System-level browser changes (e.g., Flags, Languages) usually require a restart (Relaunch) to take effect.
Execute a mandatory 'wait' action after triggering page loads, downloads, or form submissions to ensure the DOM is ready.
When filtering or searching, ensure the final state is visually verified (e.g., checking URL parameters or result counts).
Chrome browser settings do not control search engine behavior (e.g., results per page). These settings are managed by the search engine website itself, not by the browser.
Changing Chrome's interface language requires language packs to be pre-installed in the system. If a language pack is not available, the language cannot be changed.
Chrome's dark mode is often tied to OS-level appearance settings on Linux systems. Browser-level dark mode settings may not override system-level theme preferences.
